fix(core): enhance image processing resilience and fallback mechanisms in `MediaCacheManager`
- **Graceful Fallbacks & Error Handling**: - Refactored `getOptimizedImage` and `getImageThumbnail` to return the original file instead of throwing exceptions when optimization or thumbnail generation fails. - Updated `_processImageInIsolate` and `_generateThumbnailInIsolate` to return `null` on failures, allowing callers to handle unsupported formats gracefully. - Added a global try-catch fallback in media retrieval methods to ensure the original media is returned if processing crashes. - **Format Validation**: - Introduced `_supportedImageExtensions` and `_isSupportedImageFormat` to skip processing for unsupported file types (e.g., HEIC, TIFF, SVG) early in the lifecycle. - Improved logging for unsupported formats and processing cancellations to aid debugging without impacting user experience. - **Isolate & Compression Enhancements**: - Updated `_generateImageThumbnail` (main thread) to handle `null` results from `FlutterImageCompress` and log warnings instead of rethrowing. - Enhanced error messages in `IsolateManager` to explicitly list supported image extensions when decoding fails. - Switched from hard exceptions to `_logger.w` warnings for transient processing issues in background tasks.

- **Windows Build & Distribution**: - Added `build_windows.ps1` to automate Flutter Windows builds with support for ZIP, Inno Setup (.exe), and MSIX packaging. - Added `release_windows.ps1` to handle version bumping in `pubspec.yaml`, MSIX configuration updates, and automated packaging in a single flow. - Created `installer/oxii_chat_setup.iss` for Inno Setup, featuring automatic version detection from the executable, app-in-use detection, and persistent user data across updates. - **Documentation & Guides**: - Added `scripts/BUILD_README.md` providing comprehensive documentation on the release process, versioning strategy (SemVer), and platform-specific prerequisites. - Included a comparison of distribution formats (ZIP vs. Installer vs. MSIX) to guide selection based on customer needs. - **Tooling & Automation**: - Integrated new release commands and "skills" documentation for AI-assisted workflows, defining clear steps for bumping versions and verifying outputs. - Standardized output paths to `build/distribution/{windows,macos}/` for consistent artifact management. - **Cross-Platform Support**: - Established a unified script structure for both Windows (`.ps1`) and macOS (`.sh`) release lifecycles, including support for staging and production flavors.

feat(chat): implement desktop hover actions and refactor error handling
- **Desktop Chat UX**: - Introduced `DesktopMessageHoverWrapper` to provide a floating action bar on desktop hover, featuring quick reactions, reply, forward, and a "More" actions menu. - Added `MessageHoverActionBar` and `MoreActionsPopup` (using `OverlayEntry`) to handle contextual message interactions without UI flicker. - Implemented a 200ms hide delay and scroll-listener dismissal for the hover bar to ensure smooth interaction. - Added right-click (secondary tap) support to directly open the message action menu on desktop. - Integrated `MessageActionCallbacks` to standardize action passing (Copy, Edit, Delete, Select, React) across the message widget tree.
